description: This file defines the ClientRepository class responsible for managing OAuth client entities within the OrangeHRM system. It implements methods to retrieve and validate OAuth clients based on identifiers and secrets, integrating with the OAuth2 server library and system-specific entities and DTOs.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: A repository class for managing OAuth client entities, providing methods to retrieve client information and validate client credentials as part of the OAuth2 server integration.

methods.name: getOAuthClientById
methods.description: Retrieves an OAuthClient entity from the database based on the client identifier if it is enabled.

methods.name: getClientEntity
methods.description: Returns a client entity object compatible with OAuth2 server interface, fetched by client identifier.

methods.name: validateClient
methods.description: Validates the client credentials and grant type, ensuring the client exists, is enabled, and secret matches if required.

methods.name: validateClientSecret
methods.description: Checks if the provided user credential matches the stored client secret, verifying passwords securely.
